Stillness at the Center

You become very quiet, then touch the point their balance cannot afford to lose.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Touch the point where effort becomes imbalance. No weapon required.

- Weak: 4 physical damage and Slowed 1. - Standard: 4 physical damage, Slowed 1 and Dazed 1. - Strong: 6 physical damage, Slowed 1 and Dazed 2.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Athletics 3

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: stillness-at-the-center
